comment: A loop you hold, that keeps spiralling. Spiral's self-oscillation at maximum feedback was its most interesting behaviour and its least usable, because the only exit was a power cycle. Gyre is that on purpose: two overlapping grains whose windows sum to exactly 1 make the loop unity-throughput, so Decay=0 holds by arithmetic rather than by a gain that happened to land above unity -- and backing Decay off always releases it.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category, matching the rest of the release pack.
fxid_comment: 0x1E4. Free as of the 2026-08-28 fxid audit; every id in the tree is unique.

params.name: Size
params.comment: Loop length, ~40 ms to ~2.9 s, squared so the short end -- where it reads as a stutter rather than a phrase -- gets most of the travel. On knob 1: verbatim-stock LineSel handler, and the control you reach for first.

params.name: Feed
params.comment: How much of what you play enters the loop. At 0 the loop is sealed and what is already captured is all there is; turn it up and the loop keeps absorbing. This is the record control.

params.name: Decay
params.comment: 0 holds forever -- the loop neither grows nor fades, because the two-grain window sums to exactly 1. Above 0 it fades, squared so the bottom of the knob is a very slow bloom and the top a short tail. This is the way out, and it always works.

params.name: Rise
params.comment: Per-pass pitch ratio: 0 is an octave down, 50 unity, 100 an octave up. The shift COMPOUNDS around the loop, so the held audio climbs or sinks endlessly instead of sitting still.

params.name: Glide
params.comment: Depth of an onset-triggered ramp on that ratio. A new phrase resets the ramp, so the loop starts at pitch and drifts away over Span.

params.name: Span
params.comment: How long the Glide ramp takes, ~0.19 s to ~8 s. Cubic in the knob so the long end keeps its resolution.

params.name: Tone
params.comment: Low-pass inside the loop. This is what makes a held loop darken as it circulates rather than repeating identically forever.
